name: aml-consolidation
title: AML & AMLR Consolidation Chain
description: Typology risk scoring > two AML branch entry points. The AMLA transaction-typology scorer anchors both the AML Programme chain (customer risk rating onward) and the EU AMLR Single Rulebook chain (obliged-entity scope onward). Those two chains keep their own steps; this chain records the shared root and the handoff into each, so a run can start once and continue in whichever rulebook applies.

steps.handoff: overall_risk and top_risk_accounts feed both branch entry points: the aml-programme chain and the amlr-single-rulebook chain

Branch A entry point: risk_tier and composite_score continue in the aml-programme chain (TM rule building, CTR/SAR thresholds, AML Policy Mandate); those steps stay in that chain and are not repeated here

Branch B entry point: entity_type and obligations continue in the amlr-single-rulebook chain (UBO mapping, cash limit and EDD classification, CDD policy, AMLA readiness); those steps stay in that chain and are not repeated here
